messages:
Marta: heads-up 1 4dd we ran three pilot check-ins today. can we collect feature asks + any renewal flags into a tiny digest for product?
Diego: i'll grab notes. prefer a bulleted list in-thread so product can skim. columns we'll include: customer, ask, severity, renewal_risk, quote, contact, rec (docs/eng/ops), eta
Harper: adding enablement recs + whether ask blocks demo flow. i'll flag blocking items as 'demo-blocker'.
Marta: perfect. paste raw snippets below and i'll tidy into 1-line rows.
Diego: raw ->
- Blueleaf: onboarding flow hides token usage; finance rep called it "impossible to budget" -> severity: high, renewal_risk: yes, demo-blocker
- Satori: wants BYO-model routing per-tenant for compliance -> severity: med, renewal_risk: unclear
- Ember: feedback importer times out on >5000 lines, returns 504. workaround = manual split -> severity: high, renewal_risk: mentioned
Harper: note for Blueleaf: short-term we can add a billing-export sample and walkthrough. mark as docs+cs-workshop.
Diego: attaching snippet for Ember error and endpoint: `/v1/imports/csv` plus stack trace sample:
```
504 Gateway Time-out at server/ingest.js:237
Request payload size: 6.1MB
```
Marta: product, ping @product 4ac will add this digest to tomorrow's sync pre-read. can you confirm if BYO-model routing is on roadmap?
product: saw this, thanks. BYO-model routing is a strategic ask; won't be in next sprint but we'll triage priority. Ember importer looks risky 6a8525. need engineering estimate.
ops-bot: Reminder: product sync 9am PT tomorrow. add digest to pre-read.
Diego: i've cleaned CSV and uploaded to drive: <link>. 6 rows total, included call timestamps + recordings.
Harper: triage done: Ember = needs immediate triage (demo-blocker), Blueleaf = docs + billing export, Satori = place in roadmap backlog (legal review).
Marta: action list: Diego finalizes CSV with 1-5 impact score, Harper drafts enablement playbook for Blueleaf, product to estimate Ember. i'll update renewal tracker for Blueleaf and Ember.
Diego: done adding impact scores. Blueleaf=5, Ember=5, Satori=3.
product: thanks. we'll estimate Ember LOE tomorrow and tag any items that affect quarter renewals.
Marta: closing loop here. if anyone adds more pilot notes, drop them with call_ts + recording link. :white_check_mark:
